notes.title: Bug fixes, changes - v1.0.0.1r
notes.content:
Bug fixes: 
- A bug has been fixed where you incorrectly received the achievement 'Money printer' with the €80 in the tutorial

Changes:
- Customers can now be up to 40% more patient (up to 75% in the tutorial) to reduce a bit of stress
- The chance of customers not liking your food and spitting out the food on the way has been drastically reduced
- Customers no longer litter the table as often
